test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Hard had she / thrown the basketball / when it fell / on the ground.
solution:
The correct answer is ‘4’ i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the fourth part of the given sentence, the phrase 'Hard had she' is incorrect.
 
• In the given sentence, the correct phrase should be **'Hardly had she'.**
 
• This is a case of using an adverbial phrase in inversion to emphasize an action that just happened before something else.
 
 
• **Example:** ***Hardly had she** entered the room when the phone rang.*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *Hardly had she thrown the basketball when it fell on the ground.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hardly had is commonly used to describe an action that occurred just before another action. It often triggers an inversion in the sentence structure.

 
 
• **Example:** *Hardly had they finished their meal when the waiter brought the bill.*
